cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key if you admit something that could get you grounded too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. That's a weekend. This key is a month. Have you got anything bigger?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month each, then. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.

mechanism: A values its pupil confessions by expected punishment, correcting an underpriced offer before exchanging a matching secret.
confusable: Not simply testing honesty or escalating dares: each detail has an explicit equal-value price measured in personal consequences.
comparison: Names/access exchange versus a family punishment scale.
seedUse: D142 Mum key/mug/car/Jamie/flat; S05 taught not underprice secrets.
